A copper strip gains mass when heated in air and forms a black coating. What is the best particle-level explanation?

generalfeedback.text: This item assesses a Unit 1 skill. Revisit the matching lesson evidence and explain the result using the named MLA standard.

answer.text: Particles from the air combined with copper particles to form a new substance.

feedback.text: Correct. Particles from the air combined with copper particles to form a new substance.
